他忙着搅果汁，听不见你说话吧。没关系，我帮忙又不是为了听人道谢。他看起来真的很喜欢呢。

scripts.text:
[Little Lecter]
Yes, I love it! A lot! Heh heh! Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[小莱克特]
对，我超喜欢！嘿嘿！谢谢你！

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
唉...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He's happy. Why are you sighing?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他这么开心，你怎么叹气了？

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
Watching him so happy to drink that fake juice reminds me of the real agave juice I used to drink when I was young.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
看着他开心地喝这种假果汁，我想起了自己小时候喝的真正的龙舌兰汁。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
It wasn't factory-made powder. Real agave juice took so much time and effort to make that we only drank it on special occasions.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
那可不是工厂做出来的冲饮粉。真正的龙舌兰汁费时又费力，所以只有特别的日子才喝得到。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
On those days, my whole family would gather around and make agave juice together. We'd also grill steaks wrapped in agave leaves, and sometimes relatives from far away would also visit us to play music and dance together all night.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
每逢那样的日子，全家人都会聚在一起制作龙舌兰汁。我们还会用龙舌兰叶包着牛排烧烤。有时远方的亲戚也会来，大家一起奏乐、跳舞，直到深夜。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
I had so much fun as a child, but my child never got to experience any of that. Nowadays, everyone's just too busy to gather or stay up all night, singing and dancing.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
我小时候有过那么多快乐时光，可我的孩子却没机会体验。如今大家都太忙了，没空聚在一起，更别说彻夜唱歌跳舞了。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
But we Cacti want to preserve our traditions as best we can, to teach them to our children.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
不过我们仙人掌人还是想尽可能保留传统，再传给孩子们。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
Ah, I've talked too much. I'm sorry I took up your time, Adventurer.
Thank you. Please take this. It's not much, but I hope you'll like it.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
哎呀，我说得太多了。抱歉耽误你的时间，冒险者。
谢谢你，请收下这个。虽然不是什么贵重东西，希望你喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
And if you're not busy, could you come back and hunt some more coyotes? There've been more coyotes lately than before. They're part of nature, just like we are, but they're threatening our safety.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
如果你有空，能再回来帮我猎杀一些郊狼吗？最近郊狼比以前多了。它们和我们一样都是自然的一部分，但也威胁着我们的安全。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
I may not be able to give my son real agave juice, but I at least want to be able to go buy things he wants.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
我也许没法给儿子喝真正的龙舌兰汁，但至少想买得起他喜欢的东西。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
I'll appreciate if you can help me every day, starting from today.
I'll really appreciate if you can help for a little longer. You inspire me to try harder to make a better life for my son.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
如果你从今天起每天都能来帮我，我会很感激。
要是你能再多帮一阵子，我就更加感激了。你让我有动力继续努力，给儿子更好的生活。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
You need to stop what you're doing and look at it sometimes, or you'll miss important details.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
有时得停下手边的事，好好看看周围，不然就会漏掉重要的细节。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
As always, I'm grateful for your help, but you need to come back in the morning. Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
一如既往，多谢你帮忙。不过请明天早上再来。谢谢。

scripts.text:
Strange Adventurer, thank you for coming back.
You came to hunt coyotes for me, right?
scripts.translation:
好心的冒险者，谢谢你又来了。
你是来帮我猎杀郊狼的，对吧？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是。

scripts.text: No, I came to talk.
scripts.translation: 不是，我是来聊聊的。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
You're not as busy as usual, huh?
I'm not too busy myself either, thanks to you.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
今天看起来没平时那么忙呢？
多亏了你，我最近也清闲了些。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
Having something to do is a blessing.
We wake up in the morning, work to repay nature's gifts, and go to bed at night.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
有事情做是种福气。
早晨起床，努力工作以回报大自然的馈赠，晚上再好好休息。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
But of course, you need time to rest, like now. Working all day and not resting makes one's life dull.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
当然，也得留些时间休息，就像现在这样。整天忙个不停却不休息，日子会变得乏味。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
As always, please hunt ^0000CD30 Coyotes^000000 for me.
Every night, they show up in groups, yipping as if to say we'd never be able to get rid of all of them.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
照旧，请帮我猎杀^0000CD30只郊狼^000000。
每天晚上它们就成群结队地出现，嗷嗷叫着，仿佛在说我们永远也杀不完它们。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
But I believe one small change a day can eventually make a huge difference.
And you're making it possible. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
但我相信，每天一点小小的改变，日积月累也能带来巨大的不同。
这一切都多亏了你。谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
I asked you to hunt 30 Coyotes. How many did you hunt?
If you're tired, get some rest first. I don't want to burden you with my request.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
我请你猎杀30只郊狼，进展如何？
累了就先休息吧，我不想给你添太多负担。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
You came back from hunting. I'm not burdening you with this, am I?
Please keep hunting coyotes as often as you can. They'll be just as troublesome to you as they are to us if you plan to visit this place frequently.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
你打猎回来了。我的请求没有给你添麻烦吧？
有空就多帮忙赶走些郊狼吧。以后你常来这里的话，它们也会像骚扰我们一样烦你。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
This is the best I can do. I hope you'll like it. I'd like to thank you for your help on behalf of my family.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
这是我能拿出的最好谢礼，希望你喜欢。
我谨代表全家感谢你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Little Lecter]
I love agave-flavored juice. I want to drink it every day.
scripts.translation:
[小莱克特]
我最喜欢龙舌兰味果汁了，真想每天都喝！

scripts.text:
[Little Lecter]
Agave juice? Do you mean my favorite agave-flavored juice?
scripts.translation:
[小莱克特]
龙舌兰汁？你是说我最喜欢的那种龙舌兰味果汁吗？

scripts.text:
[Little Lecter]
Mom said she'd bring me agave-flavored juice. My agave-flavored juice...
scripts.translation:
[小莱克特]
妈妈说会给我带龙舌兰味果汁。我的果汁...

scripts.text:
[Little Lecter]
Wah! WAH! My agave-flavored juice!
*Sniffle* How many days do I have to wait to get my agave-flavored juice? Lecter doesn't want to wa... wait... BOOHOO!
scripts.translation:
[小莱克特]
呜哇！呜哇！我的龙舌兰味果汁！
*抽泣* 我还要等几天才能喝到呀？莱克特不想再等...等...呜哇！

scripts.text:
[Little Lecter]
Wah! WAH! My agave-flavored juice!
*Sniffle* How many days do I have to wait to get my agave-flavored juice? Lecter doesn't want to wa... wait... BOOHOO!
scripts.translation:
[小莱克特]
呜哇！呜哇！我的龙舌兰味果汁！
*抽泣* 我还要等几天才能喝到呀？莱克特不想再等...等...呜哇！

scripts.text:
[Little Lecter]
Whoa, agave-flavored juice! Thank you, Adventurer!
Could you talk to my mom? I can't drink it until she says I can.
scripts.translation:
[小莱克特]
哇，是龙舌兰味果汁！谢谢你，冒险者！
你能帮我跟妈妈说说吗？她没同意之前，我还不能喝。

scripts.text: - A tattered fabric pouch is half buried in the mound of sand, but I'm carrying too much to examine it. I'd better lighten my bag first. -
scripts.translation: - 一个破旧的布袋半埋在沙堆里，但我身上带的东西太多，没法查看。最好先清出些背包空间。 -

scripts.text: - A tattered fabric pouch is half buried in the mound of sand. I think it's just trash. -
scripts.translation: - 一个破旧的布袋半埋在沙堆里。我看只是个垃圾。 -

scripts.text: - A tattered fabric pouch is half buried in the mound of sand. It could be Mrs. Cacturon's juice mix package. -
scripts.translation: - 一个破旧的布袋半埋在沙堆里。可能是卡克图隆夫人丢失的冲饮粉包装。 -

scripts.text: - I moved close and picked up the pouch. It has the juice mix brand logo on it. Fortunately, it's not torn. -
scripts.translation: - 我走近捡起布袋。上面印着冲饮粉的品牌标志。幸好袋子没有破。 -

scripts.text: - I shook the sand off the pouch and put it in my bag. -
scripts.translation: - 我抖掉布袋上的沙子，把它收进包里。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Even Mrs. Cacturon doesn't think she could get all seven packages back.
This should be enough. I'd better end; to the village and report to her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
连卡克图隆夫人都觉得找不回全部七包。
这些应该够了。该收工回村里向她报告了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, right? I also need to hunt 30 Coyotes.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，对了，我还得猎杀30只郊狼。

scripts.text: - There's something weird about this mound of sand, but but I'm carrying too much to examine it. I'd better lighten my bag first. -
scripts.translation: - 这个沙堆有些古怪，不过我身上带的东西太多，没法查看。最好先清出些背包空间。 -

scripts.text: - Someone must have piled this mound of sand. -
scripts.translation: - 这堆沙子肯定是有人堆起来的。 -

scripts.text: - A tattered fabric pouch is half buried in the mound of sand. It could be Mrs. Cacturon's juice mix package. -
scripts.translation: - 一个破旧的布袋半埋在沙堆里。可能是卡克图隆夫人丢失的冲饮粉包装。 -

scripts.text: - I moved close and picked up the pouch. It has the juice mix brand logo on it. Fortunately, it's not torn. -
scripts.translation: - 我走近捡起布袋。上面印着冲饮粉的品牌标志。幸好袋子没有破。 -

scripts.text: - I shook the sand off the pouch and put it in my bag. -
scripts.translation: - 我抖掉布袋上的沙子，把它收进包里。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Even Mrs. Cacturon doesn't think she could get all seven packages back.
This should be enough. I'd better end; to the village and report to her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
连卡克图隆夫人都觉得找不回全部七包。
这些应该够了。该收工回村里向她报告了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, right? I also need to hunt 30 Coyotes.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，对了，我还得猎杀30只郊狼。

scripts.text: - I picked up the pouch. Sweet-smelling powder started pouring out through the tears at the bottom. -
scripts.translation: - 我捡起布袋，底部的破洞里开始漏出香甜的粉末。 -

scripts.text: - It's not usable. I'll just have to leave it and look for another one. -
scripts.translation: - 这包已经不能用了。只好留在这里，再找一包。 -

scripts.text:

It seems all strangers are greedy, and you're not an exception.
Why are you carrying so much?
scripts.translation:
[荒原仙人掌人]
看来陌生人都很贪心，你也不例外。
你怎么带了这么多东西？

scripts.text: - I'd better lighten my bag and talk to him again. -
scripts.translation: - 最好先清出些背包空间，再和他谈谈。 -

scripts.text:
[Wasteland Cactuten]
Why, haven't you seen a Cactus in this wasteland before? I'm busy. Go on your way.
scripts.translation:
[荒原仙人掌人]
怎么，你以前没在荒原见过仙人掌人吗？我正忙着呢，走开。

scripts.text: Ask if he's seen a juice mix package.
scripts.translation: 问问他有没有看到冲饮粉包装。

scripts.text:
[{0}]

scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你有没有在这附近看到冲饮粉包装？

scripts.text:
[Wasteland Cactuten]
Juice mix package? If you're talking about the package I found stuck in between rocks, then yes, I have.
scripts.translation:
[荒原仙人掌人]
冲饮粉包装？你是说我在石缝里找到的那个吗？有啊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's Mrs. Cacturon's. Let me bring it back to her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那是卡克图隆夫人的东西，我得把它还给她。

scripts.text:
[Wasteland Cactuten]

scripts.translation:
[荒原仙人掌人]
不行。卡克图隆丢了东西，关我什么事？

scripts.text: Threaten him.
scripts.translation: 威胁他。

scripts.text: Persuade him.
scripts.translation: 劝说他。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm here on her behalf. If you keep being stubborn,
then I'll have to use force.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是替她来找东西的。你要是还这么固执，
我就只能动手了。

scripts.text:
[Wasteland Cactuten]
Blood will have blood, and I don't want that. You can have the package, stranger.
But Cacturon should be ashamed of herself for trusting thugs like you.
scripts.translation:
[荒原仙人掌人]
冤冤相报何时了，我可不想动手。袋子你拿走吧，陌生人。
不过卡克图隆居然信任你这种恶棍，也该好好反省一下。

scripts.text: - I've got the juice mix package, but I feel bad that I threatened him to get them. -
scripts.translation: - 我拿到了冲饮粉包装，但靠威胁得手，心里有些过意不去。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I've been looking for some juice mix packages because I know someone has lost them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我一直在找冲饮粉包装，因为知道有人把它们弄丢了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And this one of them, and it doesn't belong to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这个包装就是其中之一，而且不是你的东西。

scripts.text:
[Wasteland Cactuten]
You're right. It doesn't belong to me.
scripts.translation:
[荒原仙人掌人]
你说得对，这东西不属于我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then why don't you let me bring it back to its owner? Mrs. Cacturon's child is upset because he can't have his favorite juice. I only want him to be happy.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那就让我把它还给失主吧。卡克图隆夫人的孩子喝不到最喜欢的果汁，正难过呢。我只是想让他开心起来。

scripts.text:
[Wasteland Cactuten]
Mm... Your logic isn't completely flawless, but at least it proves that you know Cacturon and Lecter.
scripts.translation:
[荒原仙人掌人]
嗯...你的道理也不算无懈可击，但至少能看出你认识卡克图隆和莱克特。

scripts.text:
[Wasteland Cactuten]
Okay, I'll give it to you. But if I find out you lied to me, I'll see that you pay for betraying a Cactus's trust.
scripts.translation:
[荒原仙人掌人]
好吧，给你。但要是让我发现你在骗我，敢辜负仙人掌人的信任，你就等着付出代价吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I swear I'm not lying.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我发誓没有骗你。

scripts.text: - I've got the juice mix package. -
scripts.translation: - 我拿到了冲饮粉包装。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]

scripts.translation:
[{0}]
连卡克图隆夫人都觉得找不回全部七包。

scripts.translation: - 一只郊狼嘴里叼着什么东西，正甩着脑袋玩。可能是卡克图隆夫人丢失的冲饮粉包装。 -

scripts.text: - Maybe I should yell and scare it away. What should I yell? -
scripts.translation: - 或许我该大喊一声把它吓跑。喊什么好呢？ -

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

嗷！

scripts.translation:

陌生人...

You're obsessed with materials. Don't you know they only weigh you down?
scripts.translation:
[仙人掌女孩]
你也太沉迷收集材料了吧。难道不知道它们只会让你负重吗？

scripts.text: - I'd better lighten my bag and talk to him again. -
scripts.translation: - 最好先清出些背包空间，再和她谈谈。 -

scripts.translation:

别靠近我，否则有你好看。

scripts.translation:

冲饮粉包装？

...
...我明白了。
你说是卡克图隆夫人弄丢的。你是谁？

scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是一名冒险者，受她所托来找东西。
你要是不信，可以去村里找她问问。

scripts.text:

*Snort* Do you think I'm stupid? If you're a thief, you wouldn't be here by the time I come back from the village.
Here, take it.
scripts.translation:

*哼* 你当我傻吗？要是你是小偷，等我从村里回来，你早就跑了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you just going to give it to me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你就这么直接给我了？

You said Mrs. Cacturon sent you, and I trust her. Why, do you want me to give you a hard time?
scripts.translation:
[仙人掌女孩]
你说卡克图隆夫人派你来的，我相信她。怎么，你还想让我为难你不成？

scripts.text:
[{0}]

[{0}]
不了。谢谢你把它交给我。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Hello.
May the sun and earth
bless you.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏之马]
你好。
愿太阳与大地
庇佑你。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
You're one of those strangers from a far land.
I'm Crouched Horse,
a brave warrior of the Cacti.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏之马]
你就是那些远道而来的陌生人之一吧。
我是蜷伏之马，
仙人掌人的勇士。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Ah, you're back.
Did you find the ore fragments I asked?
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏之马]
啊，你回来了。
我托你找的矿石碎片找到了吗？

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Ah, it's you.
I'm running out of
the ores.
Say, could you
help me again?
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏之马]
啊，是你。
我的矿石
快用完了。
那个，你能
再帮我一次吗？

scripts.text: [Crouched Horse]
scripts.translation: [蜷伏之马]

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
For now,
I don't need more ores.
But I will
when the sun comes up tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏之马]
暂时
我还不需要更多矿石。
不过明天
太阳升起时就需要了。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Not everything in your village
has settled.
There's a time for everything.
Go back and
help your village get settled first.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏之马]
你们村子里的事
还没有安顿好。
做事总得分先后。
先回去
帮村里安顿好吧。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
You've resolved
one of the greatest challenges your village faced.
I applaud you for your bravery and wisdom.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏之马]
你解决了
村子面临的
一大难题。
你的勇气和智慧
令我敬佩。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
If you're not busy,
could you also help my village?
It's not difficult.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏之马]
如果你有空，
能不能也帮帮我们的村子？
事情不难。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
- What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
- 我能为你做什么？

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
This place
has been
our home
for many,
many generations.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏之马]
这里
世世代代
都是
我们的
家园。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
And for a long time,
we lived in harmony with nature.
Then a few years ago
you came from a far land.
Your way of life
was different from ours.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏之马]
很长一段时间里，
我们都与自然和谐共处。
可几年前，
你们从远方来到了这里。
你们的生活方式
和我们截然不同。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
We repay Nature
for her gifts,
and we don't take
more than we need.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏之马]
我们感谢自然
赐予的一切，
只取
所需之物。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
But you do.
You liked to
take more things
than what you need.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏之马]
但你们不是。
你们总爱
拿走远超所需的
东西。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
- Because we're greedy,
- and I'm ashamed of it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
- 因为我们贪得无厌，
- 我为此感到羞愧。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
I'm not trying to blame you.
It's just that
you take so much
that there's
nothing left
for us.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏之马]
我不是想责怪你们。
只是你们
拿走得太多，
以至于
什么都没给
我们留下。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
- What do you need?
- How can I help?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
- 你们需要什么？
- 我能帮什么忙？

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
If you find purple ore fragments
while exploring this land,
I'd like you to
bring them to me.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏之马]
如果你在这片土地探险时
找到紫矿石碎片，
请把它们
带给我。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Since you opened the mine,
we've been having a hard time
finding the ores.
Say, can you do that?
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏之马]
自从你们开采矿场，
我们就很难找到矿石了。
你愿意帮忙吗？

scripts.text: Mm, not now.
scripts.translation: 嗯，现在不行。

scripts.text: Sure thing. I'll be right back.
scripts.translation: 当然可以，我这就去。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Oh, I see.
Hm... I understand.
You can come back when you're not busy.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏之马]
哦，我明白了。
嗯...没关系。
等你有空再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Oh, thank you!
You can find
purple ore fragments
while hunting in this area.
Just bring me 10. That's all I need.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏之马]
太好了，谢谢你！
在这附近打猎时
就能找到
紫矿石碎片。
带10块来就行。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Thank you.
May the sun and earth bless you!
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏之马]
谢谢你。
愿太阳与大地庇佑你！

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Hm, you don't have
all of them.
You can find them
from coyotes
and the Buffalo Bandits.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏之马]
嗯，你还没
集齐需要的数量。
郊狼和野牛强盗身上
都能找到碎片。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
- Yes, I did.

[Crouched Horse]
I don't feel good about
having to sacrifice
others
for my own sake.
Thank you for doing this for me.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏之马]
为了自己
而牺牲他人，
我心里很不好受。
谢谢你帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Please take this small token of my appreciation.
I've received it from your village,
and I don't need it.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏之马]
请收下这份小小的谢礼。
这是你们村里给我的，
我用不着。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Hm, you've brought
more than
I asked.
I know you mean well,
but I don't need so many.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏之马]
嗯，你带来的
比我要求的
还多。
我知道你是好意，
但我用不了这么多。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Next time,
please just bring
as many as I ask.
But thanks.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏之马]
下次
带够我要求的数量
就好。
不过还是谢谢你。

scripts.text: Not this time.
scripts.translation: 这次不行。

scripts.text: Sure thing. It'd be my pleasure.
scripts.translation: 当然，我很乐意帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Oh, I see.
Hm... I understand.
Feel free to come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏之马]
哦，我明白了。
嗯...没关系。
改变主意的话，随时可以回来。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Oh, thank you!
You're as reliable as I thought.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏之马]
太好了，谢谢你！
你果然和我想的一样可靠。

scripts.text: I'm carrying too many types of items. I should lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我带的物品种类太多了。得先清出些背包空间。

scripts.text: I'm overweight. I'd better lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我超重了，最好先清出些背包空间。

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
Oh, I close today. Come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[异域商人]
哦，我今天打烊了，明天再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
Nice to meet you.
I'm Abraham Iven Hudin. I'm originally from different country.
scripts.translation:
[异域商人]
幸会。
我叫亚伯拉罕·伊文·胡丁，来自别的国家。

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
So you have things that I might have interest in on buying?
scripts.translation:
[异域商人]
你有我感兴趣、愿意收购的东西吗？

scripts.text: What kinds of things?
scripts.translation: 你收什么？

scripts.text: I'm not selling anything!
scripts.translation: 我又不是来卖东西的！

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
Whoa, whoa! Adventurer is violent. I not do business with barbarians.
scripts.translation:
[异域商人]
哎哟，哎哟！冒险者脾气真大。我不和野蛮人做生意。

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
I travels the world and bought valuable things. This time I collecting specialty products of this new continent.
scripts.translation:
[异域商人]
我走遍世界各地，收购珍贵物品。这次来是想收集这片新大陆的特产。

scripts.text: (I can barely understand his English.)
scripts.translation: （我几乎听不懂他的英语。）

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
Mm? What have you said?
scripts.translation:
[异域商人]
嗯？你刚才说什么？

scripts.text: Nothing. Go on.
scripts.translation: 没什么，您继续。

scripts.text: I said I can't understand what you're saying.
scripts.translation: 我说，我听不懂你在说什么。

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
Adventurer have a cold heart!
scripts.translation:
[异域商人]
冒险者的心真冷！

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
Anyway, I looking for things that can only find in this place. If you found them, gimme them.
scripts.translation:
[异域商人]
总之，我在找只有这里才有的东西。你要是找到了，就卖给我吧。

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
I'll pay you good. You welcomes all the time.
scripts.translation:
[异域商人]
我会出个好价钱，随时欢迎你来。

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
What have you brought my today?
scripts.translation:
[异域商人]
你今天带了什么来？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: [Exotic Merchant]
scripts.translation: [异域商人]

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
Mm, do you want your things back?
scripts.translation:
[异域商人]
嗯，想把东西拿回去吗？

scripts.text: Mm, do you want your things back?
scripts.translation: 嗯，想把东西拿回去吗？

scripts.text: [Exotic Merchant]
scripts.translation: [异域商人]

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
Mm? Where are they? The things you said will give me.
scripts.translation:
[异域商人]
嗯？你说要给我的东西呢？

scripts.text: Mm? Where are they? The things you said will give me.
scripts.translation: 嗯？你说要给我的东西呢？

scripts.text: [Exotic Merchant]
scripts.translation: [异域商人]

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
It good business. These I didn't see anywhere else. I like them very much!
scripts.translation:
[异域商人]
这笔买卖不错。这些东西别处都见不到，我很喜欢！

scripts.text: It good business. These I didn't see anywhere else. I like them very much!
scripts.translation: 这笔买卖不错。这些东西别处都见不到，我很喜欢！

scripts.text: I'm carrying too many types of items. I should lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我带的物品种类太多了。得先清出些背包空间。

scripts.text: I'm overweight. I'd better lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我超重了，最好先清出些背包空间。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
What? I don't have enough food for you!
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
什么？我没有多余的食物给你！

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Hey, don't you see the line over there? I don't care who you are? go stand in line if you want to eat.
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
喂，没看见那边排着队吗？不管你是谁，想吃东西就去排队！

scripts.text: I'm not here to eat.
scripts.translation: 我不是来吃东西的。

scripts.text: I'll stand in line.
scripts.translation: 我去排队。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
*Snort* You'd better.
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
*哼* 这还差不多。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
You're not here to eat. Err, is that...? Ah, my apologies.
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
你不是来吃东西的？呃，那是...？啊，抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Wait, then why are you bothering me? Can't you see I'm upset because of the missing shipment?
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
那你来烦我干什么？没看见货物不见了，我正心烦吗？

scripts.text: What missing shipment?
scripts.translation: 什么货物不见了？

scripts.text: That's your business.
scripts.translation: 那是你的事。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Grr, you're a jerk. I don't have time for this. Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
啧，你这人真讨厌。我没空跟你废话。快走！

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Look at that. Those people have been waiting for their food for hours. How can I tell them that I don't have enough ingredients to cook for them?
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
你看那些人，排了好几个小时，就等着领饭。我该怎么告诉他们，我没有足够的食材给他们做饭？

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
The food ingredients that were supposed to come from Midgard didn't arrive, and I can't keep these people waiting.
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
本该从米德加尔特送来的食材一直没到，我不能让大家继续等下去。

scripts.text: Why don't you procure some ingredients from the outside?
scripts.translation: 你为什么不从外面想办法弄些食材？

scripts.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Good luck.
scripts.translation: 真替你发愁。祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Grr, you're a jerk. I don't have time for this. Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
啧，你这人真讨厌。我没空跟你废话。快走！

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
I thought about it. I was desperate enough to try anything.
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
我也考虑过了。当时真是急疯了，什么办法都想试。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
But there are only sand and rocks out there, and nothing edible. I can't believe I thought I could run a kitchen in a place like this.
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
可外面除了沙子和石头什么都没有，根本找不到能吃的东西。我真不敢相信自己竟想在这种地方开厨房。

scripts.text:
[Hungry Laborer]
^990000Wait, did you just say you have no ingredients? You ran out of them?^000000
scripts.translation:
[饥饿的劳工]
^990000等等，你刚才说没有食材了？都用光了吗？^000000

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
^990000No, I didn't say that! It's just taking a little longer to cook today. Stop panicking!^000000
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
^990000不，我可没这么说！只是今天做饭要多花点时间。别慌！^000000

scripts.text: I can help.
scripts.translation: 我可以帮忙。

scripts.text: Good luck.
scripts.translation: 祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Grr, you're a jerk. I don't have time for this. Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
啧，你这人真讨厌。我没空跟你废话。快走！

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
You can help. How?
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
你能帮忙？怎么帮？

scripts.text: You need food ingredients, don't you?
scripts.translation: 你需要食材，对吧？

scripts.text: That depends on you.
scripts.translation: 那就看你的了。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Alright, then let's do this. I'll jot down everything I need. Can you bring them from Midgard?
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
好，那就这么办。我把要的东西列下来。你能从米德加尔特带来吗？

scripts.text: Sure thing.
scripts.translation: 没问题。

scripts.text: It'd be a waste of my time if I say no now.
scripts.translation: 现在拒绝的话，我这趟不就白费口舌了。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Good! We've made a deal. I need some time to take inventory. Talk to me again later.
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
好！一言为定。我得花点时间盘点，待会儿再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
This should be enough for the day today.
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
今天这些应该够用了。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Bring me 160 {0} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
从米德加尔特给我带160个{0}。大城市的商人那里就能买到。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Whew, thank you. This should be enough for the day today.
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
呼，谢谢你。这些食材今天应该够用了。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Bring me 50 {0} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
从米德加尔特给我带50个{0}。大城市的商人那里就能买到。

scripts.translation:

从米德加尔特给我带60个{0}。大城市的商人那里就能买到。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Whew, thank you. This should be enough for the day today.
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
呼，谢谢你。这些食材今天应该够用了。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Aww, here's the list of ingredients I need. Bring them quickly, will you?
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
哎呀，这是我需要的食材清单。快点带来，好吗？

scripts.text: Sure thing.
scripts.translation: 没问题。

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我正忙着。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Oh, come on. Help me out here. People are starving.
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
拜托，帮帮忙吧。大家都快饿坏了。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Sweet potato croquettes are on the menu today, and I can't make them because I didn't get the regular shipment from the mainland.
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
今天菜单上有红薯可乐饼，可我没收到大陆送来的常规货物，做不了。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Bring me 160 {0} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
从米德加尔特给我带160个{0}。大城市的商人那里就能买到。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
There are so many mouths to feed, and yet I've got no meat? This is disaster!
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
这么多张嘴等着吃饭，我手头却连肉都没有？这下糟了！

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
What? I could always feed them veggies, you say? Sure, but all they want is meat.
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
什么？你说可以给他们吃蔬菜？是可以，可他们想吃的都是肉。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Bring me 50 {0} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
从米德加尔特给我带50个{0}。大城市的商人那里就能买到。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Have you seen the carrots growing in the garden in the back?
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
你看到后院菜园里种的胡萝卜了吗？

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
They're as thin as fingers, and once I almost put my fingers into a stew instead of them.
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
它们细得跟手指似的，有次我差点把自己的手指当胡萝卜丢进炖锅里。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Bring me 160 {0} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
从米德加尔特给我带160个{0}。大城市的商人那里就能买到。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
I shouldn't have put that banana bread on the menu. Who knew they wouldn't arrive in time?
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
我真不该把香蕉面包写进菜单。谁知道货送不到呢？

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Bring me 160 {0} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
从米德加尔特给我带160个{0}。大城市的商人那里就能买到。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
I have to cook a pumpkin stew, but I don't have pumpkins. This is the equivalent of making toast without bread.
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
我得做南瓜浓汤，可手头没有南瓜。这就像没有面包却要做吐司。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Bring me 160 {0} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
从米德加尔特给我带160个{0}。大城市的商人那里就能买到。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
The only thing I can cook with the ingredients I have is mushroom soup, but I don't have the main ingredient: mushrooms.
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
我手头的食材只够做蘑菇汤，偏偏连主料蘑菇都没有。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Bring me 60 {0} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation:
[食物发放员]
从米德加尔特给我带60个{0}。大城市的商人那里就能买到。

scripts.text: I'm carrying too many types of items. I should lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我带的物品种类太多了。得先清出些背包空间。

scripts.text: I'm overweight. I'd better lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我超重了，最好先清出些背包空间。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Sorry, but we need someone stronger than you.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
抱歉，我们需要比你更强的人。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Hey, buddy. You look pretty strong. You're here to work, right?
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
嘿，朋友，你看起来挺强壮的。是来干活的吧？

scripts.text: No. I'm just a tourist.
scripts.translation: 不是，我只是来观光的。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Come on, don't be so heartless. I'm trying to strike up a conversation here. I've got a proposition that you might be interested. What do you say?
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
别这么冷淡嘛，我只是想和你聊聊。我有个你可能感兴趣的提议，怎么样？

scripts.text: Alright, let me hear it.
scripts.translation: 好吧，说来听听。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Oh, you don't. *Smacks his lips* How disappointing!
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
哦，你没兴趣啊。*咂咂嘴* 真叫人失望！

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Ah, so you're not as snobbish as I thought.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
啊，看来你没我想的那么傲慢。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
For Rock Ridge to become a transport hub, the monsters that live around it have got to go, but we can't find the right people for the job.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
要让洛克理奇成为交通枢纽，就得清除周边的魔物，可我们一直找不到合适的人手。

scripts.text: What about all these people?
scripts.translation: 那边那些人呢？

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
*Snort* These? Yeah, we thought they were good enough until we realized how strong the monsters out there were.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
*哼* 他们？我们本来也以为他们能胜任，直到发现外面的魔物有多厉害。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
None of these guys would come back alive, let alone earn their keep. And then we'd have to go out there to collect their remains, which is doubly bad for us.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
这些人根本没人能活着回来，更别说完成工作了。到时候我们还得出去收尸，对我们来说更是麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Then I saw you, and you stood out like a wolf among sheep. That is, you've passed! Congratulations!
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
然后我就看见了你。你在他们当中格外显眼，简直鹤立鸡群。也就是说，你通过考验了！恭喜！

scripts.text: I never said I wanted to work with you.
scripts.translation: 我可没说要替你干活。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Ah, come on, don't be like that. Help this poor man out here.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
哎呀，别这样嘛。帮帮我这个可怜人吧。

scripts.text: Okay.
scripts.translation: 好吧。

scripts.text: Let me think.
scripts.translation: 让我考虑一下。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Okay, okay, I understand if you're busy. But I'm offering you benefits both of us.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
好吧，我知道你可能很忙。不过这提议对咱们双方都有好处。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
How about I show you the list of things you could do for us? If you're interested, come back later. I promise I'll pay you generously.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
这样吧，我把能帮我们做的事列给你。感兴趣的话，之后再来找我。我保证报酬丰厚。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
The worst is over. I'll need your help again. Save your energy until then, alright?
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
最难熬的时期已经过去了。之后还得麻烦你帮忙。在那之前先养精蓄锐吧。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Did you forget what you have to do? Then, I'll tell you again.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
忘了要做什么了吗？那我再告诉你一遍。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
The biggest threat in the fields around here is the Buffalo Bandits. They're smart and ruthless, and they won't listen to reason.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
这附近田野里最大的威胁就是野牛强盗。他们既狡猾又残暴，根本不听人讲道理。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
And they've been invading this village every so often, as if to test how long we could last.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
他们还时不时来袭击村子，像是在试探我们能撑多久。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
We want to set an example and keep them in check. Get rid of ^0000ff15 Buffalo Bandits with rifles^000000.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
我们得杀鸡儆猴，让他们收敛些。去解决^0000ff15个持步枪的野牛强盗^000000。

scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
我们得杀鸡儆猴，让他们收敛些。去解决^0000ff15个戴眼罩的野牛强盗^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Did you forget what you have to do? Then, I'll tell you again.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
忘了要做什么了吗？那我再告诉你一遍。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
The Cacti and the members of this village are on good terms, and recently more coyotes have been seen along the road that leads to their village.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
仙人掌人和村民一向相处融洽，最近通往他们村子的路上却出现了越来越多郊狼。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Coyotes aren't aggressive, but they still keep the Cacti from coming in and out of their village freely.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
郊狼虽然不主动攻击人，但害得仙人掌人没法自由进出村子。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Please hunt ^0000ff20 Coyotes^000000 and help our friends.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
请猎杀^0000ff20只郊狼^000000，帮帮我们的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
The workers who were sent down to the basement of the village went missing one after another, so we investigated. We believe they were killed by monsters.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
派到村子地下室的工人接连失踪，我们调查后发现，他们很可能是被魔物杀害了。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Swamp Arclouzes are fast, carnivorous insects living down there, and their number has been increasing at such an alarming rate that workers now refuse to go in there to work.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
沼泽卷甲虫是地下室里行动迅速的肉食性昆虫，数量正以惊人的速度增加，工人们都不敢下去干活了。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
If you have business down there, please exterminate 10 ^0000ffSwamp Arclouzes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
如果你要下去办事，请消灭10只^0000ff沼泽卷甲虫^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
The bodies of the workers who went missing in the basement have been found. They were mangled so badly that even their families had a hard time recognizing them.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
失踪工人的尸体已经在地下室找到了。他们被撕咬得面目全非，连家人都难以辨认。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
I think they were killed by brown rats that thrive in the basement. Rumor has it they even attack living people, and if it holds true, that's serious.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
我觉得是地下室里泛滥的褐鼠杀了他们。听说那些老鼠甚至会袭击活人，要是真的就麻烦了。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
If you have business in the basement, please exterminate 10 ^0000ffBrown Rats^000000.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
如果你要去地下室，请消灭10只^0000ff褐鼠^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
You're amazing? I didn't know you could really do this! Thanks!
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
你真行啊！没想到你真能办到！多谢了！

scripts.text: I'm carrying too many types of items. I should lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我带的物品种类太多了。得先清出些背包空间。

scripts.text: I'm overweight. I'd better lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我超重了，最好先清出些背包空间。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Hah hah, thank you for your interest, but we're not desperate enough to need help from little kids like you.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
哈哈，多谢你有这份心，不过我们还没落魄到要找你这种小孩帮忙。

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou must be Level 140 or above to receive this quest.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff需要达到140级或更高等级才能接取此任务。^000000

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Mm? You're not one of us. If you need a job, then you should look elsewhere.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
嗯？你不是我们义警队的人。想找活干的话，去别处看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
You're good. I'd love to work with you again.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
你干得不错。希望下次还能合作。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
You're pretty strong. Can you handle something tough?
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
你挺强的，能接下棘手的活吗？

scripts.text: Sure, why not?
scripts.translation: 当然可以。

scripts.text: Let me think.
scripts.translation: 让我想想。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Alright, take your time.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
好，慢慢考虑。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Did you forget what you have to do? Then, I'll tell you again.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
忘了要做什么了吗？那我再告诉你一遍。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Elite Buffalo Bandits are leaders among the Buffalo Bandits, and this is about them.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
精英野牛强盗是强盗中的头目，这次要对付的就是他们。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
You've dealt with the buffaloes with rifles before, haven't you? Then you must have seen those with ^0000ffglowing blue eyes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
你之前对付过持步枪的野牛强盗吧？那肯定见过那些^0000ff双眼泛着蓝光^000000的家伙。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
They're the middle-ranking officers of rifle buffaloes. I want you to get rid of 10 ^0000ffrifle Buffalo Bandits with glowing blue eyes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
他们是持步枪强盗里的中层头目。去解决10只^0000ff双眼泛蓝光的持步枪野牛强盗^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Elite Buffalo Bandits are leaders among the Buffalo Bandits, and this is about them.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
精英野牛强盗是强盗中的头目，这次要对付的就是他们。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
You've dealt with the masked buffaloes before, haven't you? Then you must have seen those wearing ^0000ffgreen masks^000000.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
你之前对付过戴面具的野牛强盗吧？那肯定见过那些戴着^0000ff绿面具^000000的家伙。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
They're the middle-ranking officers of masked buffaloes. I want you to get rid of 10 ^0000ffBuffalo Bandits wearing green masks^000000.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
他们是戴面具强盗里的中层头目。去解决10只^0000ff戴绿面具的野牛强盗^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Elite Buffalo Bandits are leaders among the Buffalo Bandits, and this is about them.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
精英野牛强盗是强盗中的头目，这次要对付的就是他们。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
You've dealt with the buffaloes with an eye patch before, haven't you? Then you must have seen those wearing ^0000ffpale green vests^000000.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
你之前对付过戴眼罩的野牛强盗吧？那肯定见过那些穿着^0000ff浅绿色背心^000000的家伙。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
They're the middle-ranking officers of sword buffaloes. I want you to get rid of 10 ^0000ffBuffalo Bandits wearing an eye patch and a pale green vest^000000.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
他们是持剑强盗里的中层头目。去解决10只^0000ff戴眼罩、穿浅绿色背心的野牛强盗^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Some miners have reported to us about gas-like monsters that spread a neurotoxin.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
有矿工报告说，出现了一种会散播神经毒素的气体状魔物。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
They're purple monsters named Gasters. They don't attack unless they're provoked, but they still pose a threat.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
那是紫色的瓦斯魔。只要不招惹它们，它们就不会攻击，但仍然很危险。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Please hunt 10 ^0000ffGasters^000000 in the mine outside the village.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
请到村外的矿场猎杀10只^0000ff瓦斯魔^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
You're good. I'd love to work with you again.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
你干得不错。希望下次还能合作。

scripts.text: I'm carrying too many types of items. I should lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我带的物品种类太多了。得先清出些背包空间。

scripts.text: I'm overweight. I'd better lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我超重了，最好先清出些背包空间。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
What are you doing here? You're not good enough to earn your keep. Out!
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
你在这儿干什么？你根本不够格领工钱。出去！

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
My office is filled with thieves. Everyone expects to be paid? Without doing their job!
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
我办公室里全是想白拿钱的小偷！人人都想领工资，却没人肯干活！

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
And you. How much were you going to ask me for? Just so you know, we don't allow payroll advances.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
还有你，你想跟我要多少钱？先说好，我们不准预支工资。

scripts.text: I'm just a passersby.
scripts.translation: 我只是路过。

scripts.text: I want 100 million Zeny in advance.
scripts.translation: 我想预支一亿 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
...
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
...

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
You're out of your mind.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
你疯了吧。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Mm? But you look too strong to be a simple passersby.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
嗯？你看起来这么强，可不像普通路人。

scripts.text: Well, I don't have any business here. I should go.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我没什么事，还是走吧。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
WAIT!
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
等一下！

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Wait. Yes.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
等等，对了。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Hey, Jamie! How many more workers did you say we need in the culvert?
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
杰米！你说排水沟那边还缺多少工人？

scripts.text:
[Jamie]
^000077Since 2 more disappeared yesterday, 15. No one wants to go down there.^000000
scripts.translation:
[杰米]
^000077昨天又有2个人失踪了，所以还缺15个。没人愿意下去。^000000

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Hear that? Our office is severely understaffed.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
听见了吧？我们这边严重缺人。

scripts.text: But what about all these people who are eager to work?
scripts.translation: 可这里不是有这么多人抢着要工作吗？

scripts.text: Not my business.
scripts.translation: 不关我的事。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Hey, come on! I'm not finished!
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
喂，别急着走！我还没说完！

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
They're eager, all right, but none of them is strong enough to be useful.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
他们是很积极，可惜一个个都不够强，派不上用场。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
We need a lot of people at a construction site. It's... a little bit dangerous down there, but you look like you know how to deal with danger.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
工地需要不少人手。下面...确实有点危险，不过看你挺会应付危险的。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Say, how'd you like to work for me? I'll pay you generously.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
怎么样，要不要来给我干活？报酬丰厚哦。

scripts.text: Tell me what this job entails.
scripts.translation: 先告诉我这工作具体要做什么。

scripts.text: Let me think.
scripts.translation: 让我考虑一下。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
You don't have to think! This benefits both of us!
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
这还用考虑？对咱们双方都有好处！

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Let me tell you a little bit about this village. It's built above the remains of a city that sank into the sea.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
我先介绍一下这个村子。它建在一座沉入海底的城市遗迹上。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
We can't completely fill up the basement because it's where our desalination system is.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
地下室里装着海水淡化设备，所以不能把那里完全填起来。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Let me tell you a little bit about this village. It's built above the remains of a city that sank into the sea.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
我先介绍一下这个村子。它建在一座沉入海底的城市遗迹上。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
We can't completely fill up the basement because it's where our desalination system is.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
地下室里装着海水淡化设备，所以不能把那里完全填起来。

scripts.text: Can't you get water elsewhere?
scripts.translation: 不能从别处取水吗？

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
This area is a desert. Desalinating is cheaper than importing water.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
这里是沙漠。海水淡化比从外地运水便宜。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Anyway, the desalination system itself is in good order, but the cobweb of pipes that forms the system is prone to erosion and breakage. They need constant maintenance.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
总之，设备本身运作正常，但组成系统的管道网很容易被侵蚀或损坏，必须经常维护。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Then some time ago, monsters started showing up in the basement, and now our workers are too scared to work. That's the situation we're in right now.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
可前阵子地下室开始出现魔物，工人们现在都吓得不敢干活了。眼下就是这么个情况。

scripts.text: What happens if I say no?
scripts.translation: 我如果拒绝呢？

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
This village will run out of drinking water. Someone has to do this. Believe it or not, I'm doing doing this entirely for profit.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
村里就会没有饮用水。总得有人去做。信不信由你，我可不是为了赚钱才这么忙活的。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Say, is that good enough motivation for you? If you still don't want to help us, I won't force you.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
这理由够打动你了吗？你要是不愿意帮忙，我也不勉强。

scripts.text:
[Jamie]
^000077Mr. Chairman, I've just got a call from the basement. Five more workers have been attacked by monsters.^000000
scripts.translation:
[杰米]
^000077主席先生，我刚接到地下室打来的电话。又有5名工人遭到魔物袭击。^000000

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Uh-oh, I'd better go take care of that situation. Come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
糟了，我得去处理一下。改变主意的话再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Aren't you tired? The pipes don't need cleaning at this moment. Why don't you go take care of whatever else you have to do?
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
你不累吗？现在不用清理管道。先去处理别的事情吧。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Does this mean you're willing to go downstairs?
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
所以你愿意下去了吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 愿意。

scripts.text: Let me think.
scripts.translation: 让我考虑一下。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Alright, take your time.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
好，慢慢考虑。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Good. Let me tell you what to do. Take a look at the door at the bottom of the water storage to the left side of me. It's connected to the basement.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
好，我来告诉你该做什么。看看我左手边水槽底部那扇门，它通往地下室。

scripts.text: Do you mean the door that looks like a portal?
scripts.translation: 你是说那扇像传送门一样的门吗？

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Yes. Usually it's closed, and only those who have business in the basement can use it,
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
没错。平时那扇门是关着的，只有需要去地下室工作的人才能进去，

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
You know, people who help the Vigilantes, clean the sewer, and maintain the desalination pipes, like you.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
比如帮义警做事、清理下水道、维护海水淡化管道的人。现在你也要做这些。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Your job is to find four different types of pipes and fasten their bolts to prevent leakage.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
你要找出四种不同的管道，把螺栓拧紧，防止漏水。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
The pipes that need maintenance are colored differently for easy recognition. When you're ready, enter the door on the left side.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
需要维护的管道颜色各不相同，很容易辨认。准备好后就从左边的门进去。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
You haven't finished cleaning the pipes. We'll run out of water soon. Could you hurry up?
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
管道还没修好吗？村里快没水了，能不能抓紧一点？

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Good job. The villagers can enjoy clean water for the rest of the day, and it's all because of you.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施经理]
干得好！多亏了你，村民今天剩下的时间都能用上干净水了。

scripts.text:
[Jamie]
Could you stop hitting on me? I'm the Chairman's personal secretary.
scripts.translation:
[杰米]
别再对我毛手毛脚了好吗？我是主席的私人秘书。

scripts.text: ^0000ffWarning: This place is not for the weak or faint-hearted.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff警告：胆小或懦弱的人不宜进入此地。^000000

scripts.text: ^0000ffDo you want to move to the underground village?^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff要前往地下村庄吗？^000000

scripts.text: Move.
scripts.translation: 前往

scripts.text: Do it later.
scripts.translation: 稍后再说

scripts.text: You have decided not to use the underground passage.
scripts.translation: 你决定不走地下通道。

scripts.text: ^0000ffDo you want to go above ground?^000000
Move.
scripts.translation: 前往

scripts.text: Do it later.
scripts.translation: 稍后再说

scripts.text: You have decided not to use the menu.
scripts.translation: 你决定不使用此选项。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Hello.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
你好。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
You're one of the adventurers from the mainland, right?
My name is Donovan,
sewer system manager.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
你是从大陆来的冒险者吧？
我叫多诺万，
负责管理下水道系统。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Ah, Adventurer, welcome back.
How was it, getting rid of sea anemones?
It wasn't too difficult, was it?
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
啊，冒险者，欢迎回来。
清理海葵怎么样？
应该不算太难吧？

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Oh, so you're
the adventurer who took care of the Buffalo Bandits!
Nice to meet you!
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
哦，你就是解决了野牛强盗问题的冒险者啊！
幸会！

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Ah, welcome back!
I've been thinking
it's time to
get rid of sea anemones again.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
啊，欢迎回来！
我正想着
该再次
清理海葵了。

scripts.text: [Donovan]
scripts.translation: [多诺万]

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
The pipes are
clear of sea anemones at this moment.
Why don't you
come back later?
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
现在管道里的海葵
已经清理干净了。
过些时候
再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Go east,
and you'll see Joe.
He'll let you
go down to the basement
if you tell him I sent you.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
往东走
就能看到乔。
告诉他是我派你来的，
他就会放你下地下室。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
There are so many problems
the Buffalo Bandits, the mine, just to name a couple?
that no one else cares about their own sewer system right now.
The Buffalo Bandits
need to be taken care of first.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
现在麻烦事太多了，
野牛强盗、矿场，光这些就够头疼了，
没人顾得上下水道。
得先解决野牛强盗的问题。

scripts.text: I can do that.
scripts.translation: 我可以去处理。

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我正忙着。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Oh, I see.
I understand.
But come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
哦，明白了。
没关系，改变主意的话再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
You know how to enter the basement, right?
Thank you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
你知道怎么下地下室了吧？
多谢帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
So, you're strong enough to
take care of the bandits.
Would you be so kind
as to help me with something?
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
看来你有本事对付那些强盗。
能不能也帮我一件事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
- Alright, what can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
- 好啊，我能帮什么忙？

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Oh, where are my manners?
My name is Donovan,
sewer system manager.
I manage the underground water pump
and sewage system.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
哎呀，失礼了。
我叫多诺万，
负责管理下水道系统。
地下抽水泵和排污系统也归我管。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Groundwater keeps welling up
from the basement of the village,
and it has to be pumped out into the sea
to prevent flooding.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
地下水不断从村子地下室涌出来，
必须抽进海里，
不然就会淹水。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
My job is to make sure
the pumps and sewage system are
in working order
at all times,
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
我的工作就是确保
水泵和排污系统
时刻保持
正常运转，

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
and it's not a job for just one man.
There are so many things to do
that I need help.
The work itself isn't complicated.
Could you help me?
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
这活可不是一个人忙得过来的。
要做的事太多，我需要帮手。
工作本身倒不复杂。
你愿意帮我吗？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 好啊。

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我正忙着。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Oh, I see.
I understand.
But come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
哦，我明白。
没关系，改变主意的话再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Wow, thank you!
All you have to do is
go down to the basement
and get rid of sea anemones
on the pipes and water pump.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
太好了，谢谢你！
你只要
下到地下室，
清除管道和水泵上的
海葵就行了。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
You can go down to the basement
by talking to
Joe, who's a bit east of here.
He'll let you
go down to the basement.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
找乔就能下地下室，
他就在这附近偏东一点。
他会放你
下去的。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
We call him Quiet Joe.
Thank you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
我们都叫他“沉默的乔”。
谢谢你帮忙。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
- No, it wasn't.
- It was boring, though.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
- 不难。
- 不过挺无聊的。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Hah hah, it's a boring job, sure.
But it must not be boring to those sea anemones
because they spring up every day,
no matter how hard I try
to keep them in check.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
哈哈，这工作确实挺无聊。
不过那些海葵肯定不这么觉得，
不管我怎么努力控制，
它们每天都会冒出来。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Getting rid of them
takes up a lot of my time.
Thank you for your help.
I could always use help getting rid of sea anemones.
Please come again.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
清理它们
占了我不少时间。
谢谢你帮忙。
我随时都需要人手清理海葵，
欢迎再来。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
What are you looking at? Scram before I put holes in your face! Git!
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
看什么看？再不滚我就在你脸上开几个洞！滚！

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
I should go. He's just being stubborn.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
我该走了。他就是在闹脾气。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
Frankly, I don't understand why he would want to do this, but I don't want to stop him.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
说实话，我不明白他为什么非要这么做，但我不想阻止他。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
谢谢你帮我们。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
...

[Midnight]
Demon, some strange kid is just hanging out around us. Do you know him?
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
恶魔，有个奇怪的小孩一直在我们附近晃悠。你认识他吗？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Who? Where? I don't see him. Send him to me.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
谁？在哪儿？我没看见。让他过来找我。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
You're carrying so much stuff, I'm worried you might break your shoulder. Why don't you go lighten your bag first?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
你带这么多东西，我都担心你会压伤肩膀。先清出些背包空间吧。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
You're still wet behind the ears. This place is too dangerous for you. Come back later, alright?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
你还嫩着呢，这里太危险了。过些时候再来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
You have no idea how dangerous this place is, do you? Get out of here while you can.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
你根本不知道这里有多危险吧？趁还能走，赶紧离开。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
You came back quickly. Ah, I miss being young.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
你这么快就回来了。唉，真怀念年轻的时候。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
But look, I still have left some of the materials you brought me yesterday. I can't use all these.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
不过你看，昨天带来的材料我还剩下一些，根本用不完。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Why don't you go home and come back next morning?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
先回家吧，明天早上再来。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Hey, kiddo! It's very nice to see you again. The bomb I made with the materials you brought is in the aging process. Did you know wine and bombs get better the older they are?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
嘿，小家伙！很高兴又见到你。你带来的材料做成的炸弹正在熟化呢。你知道吗，酒和炸弹一样，放得越久越够味？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Now, could you bring some more materials today? We're a long way from having all the bombs we need.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
今天能再带些材料来吗？我们离凑齐需要的炸弹还差得远呢。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
As usual, get ^0000cd10 Deadly Poison Powders and 1 Explosive Powder^000000, and ^0000cdhunt 15 Gasters^000000. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
照旧，带来^0000cd10份毒药粉和1份爆炸粉^000000，再^0000cd猎杀15只瓦斯魔^000000。明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
We'll be counting on you, kiddo!
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
小家伙，这事就拜托你啦！

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Alright, this should do. You know what I need, right? Are you sure you could sneak in? Maybe I should go.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
好，这些应该够了。你知道我需要什么吧？你确定能悄悄溜进去吗？要不还是我去吧。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
I'll go while everyone's in bed.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
等大家睡着了，我就进去。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
But the noise could wake them up. There'll be guards, too.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
可动静可能会把他们吵醒，而且里面还有守卫。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
I'll be alright. We all look alike? They won't know I'm not one of them.
[Midnight]
*Glance*
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
没事，我们长得都差不多，他们认不出我不是自己人。
[午夜]
*瞥了一眼*

scripts.text: Mister, what are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 先生，你在这里做什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why are you playing with fire in the middle of nowhere? You're suspicious.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你们为什么在荒郊野外玩火？看起来很可疑啊。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
...

[Demon]
Hey, a kid is asking you a question. He looks so curious that I'm worried he might die if you don't tell him.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
喂，这孩子在问你呢。他好奇得不得了，你不告诉他，我担心他会急坏的。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
...

[Demon]
Little kids like him are full of curiosity. You'd better tell him before he starts crying.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
这孩子好奇心得很。趁他还没哭，你最好告诉他吧。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
Yo tell him.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
你告诉他。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
No. Why should I? He asked you. Plus, kids usually give me heartburn.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我才不说，凭什么？是他问你的。而且小孩总让我头疼。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
I had my favorite bean dish for breakfast today. I can't lose it. I want it to become part of me.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我今天早餐吃了最喜欢的豆子料理，可舍不得浪费。我想把它消化吸收，变成身体的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
Some of it has to come out of you eventually. Poor beans. They'd be angry to be eaten by jerks like you.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
反正最后总得排出来。可怜的豆子，竟被你这种混蛋吃掉，肯定气坏了。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Oh, right! Why don't we ask this kid?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
哦，对了！不如问问这孩子？

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
What? But we can't trust him? We've just met him!
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
什么？我们能信任他吗？我们才刚认识！

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Yes, we can. People are supposed to trust each other. You didn't know that, did you? Now that he's here, he's one of us now. And I told you, everyone's born good.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
当然能。人与人本来就该互相信任嘛，你不知道吗？他既然来了，就是我们的人了。我早告诉过你，人人生来都是善良的。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Plus, doesn't he look like he's used to rough things? He has a runner's body and keen eyes that miss nothing. I like kids like him.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
而且这孩子看起来吃得了苦。他身手敏捷，眼神也锐利，什么都逃不过他的眼睛。我喜欢这样的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Hey, kiddo. How'd you like to join us in business?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
嘿，小家伙，想不想加入我们一起做生意？

scripts.text: What business?
scripts.translation: 做什么生意？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You look dangerous. I don't want to do anything dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你们看起来很危险，我可不想干危险的事。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
You don't? Alright, then I won't force you. Take care now. This place is dangerous. You'd better get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
不想啊？好吧，我不勉强你。保重，这里很危险，最好赶紧离开。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
Are you sure we can let him go? He's seen us.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
真要放他走？他都看见我们了。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Why are you so paranoid? It's okay, kiddo. Just go. But come back if you change your mind!
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
你也太疑神疑鬼了。没事的，小家伙，走吧。改变主意的话再回来！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What business?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么生意？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
We've got a great plan.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我们有个绝妙的计划。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Unless you're going to explain it yourself, just shut up and let me do it!
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
你要是不打算亲自解释，就闭嘴让我来说！

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
...

[Demon]
That's more like it. Anyway, we're going to rob the ^0000cdmine^000000.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
这才像话。总之，我们要去抢^0000cd矿场^000000。

scripts.text: Rob the mine?
scripts.translation: 抢矿场？

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
You didn't have to tell him that. You could've just asked him to get the things for us.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
你没必要告诉他这些，直接让他帮我们拿东西不就行了。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
We can't make him do things for us without explanation. He has the right to know what he's getting himself into.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
总不能什么都不解释就让他替我们做事吧。他有权知道自己要掺和什么。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
You want to take advantage of a stranger.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
你就是想利用这个陌生人。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
No. I'm asking you to be in on our great plan. Anyway, you know the mine east of here? It used to belong to Gold Moon?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
才不是，我是在邀请你加入我们的绝妙计划。对了，你知道这附近东边的矿场吗？以前是金月的。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
So, anyway, the Buffalo Bandits realized how lucrative the mine was and took up residence in there.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
后来野牛强盗发现矿场很赚钱，就占下来住进去了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I've heard that.

[Demon]
You have? From where?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
是吗？你从哪儿听说的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
At the sheriff's office.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
警长办公室。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Hey, did you just get released? So are we! In fact, we've met there. I've met most of my best friends while we were in the system.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
嘿，你刚放出来吗？我们也是！说起来，我们在里面见过。我最好的几个朋友都是在牢里认识的。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
I miss the smell of the stone floor. And the coolness.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
我还挺怀念石地板的气味，还有那股凉意。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
I liked the food, too. I hated beans until I went to jail. All the beans I've eaten aren't half as good as those I ate in there.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我也喜欢那里的伙食。进监狱前我讨厌豆子，可我吃过的豆子没有一种比得上牢里的。

scripts.text: Why did you go to jail?
scripts.translation: 你为什么进监狱？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Oh, that.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
哦，那件事啊。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
Are you going to tell him that too?
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
你连那个也要告诉他？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Why not? I loved that story. You want to hear it, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
为什么不呢？我可喜欢讲那个故事了。你也想听吧？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
I'm really good with my hands, and I like fireworks. What do you think would be the best job for someone like me?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我手很巧，又喜欢烟火。你觉得我这种人最适合做什么工作？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Firecracker maker?

[Demon]
Close, but I make something stronger: ^0000cdbombs^000000. And mines are just about the best thing that could happen to people like me.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
差不多，不过我做的是更厉害的东西：^0000cd炸弹^000000。对我们这种人来说，矿场简直是再好不过的地方。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
People working at the mines always need bombs. I came here, hoping I could make some money while doing what I love.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
矿工总是需要炸弹。我来这里就是想一边做喜欢的事，一边赚点钱。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
But it didn't work out.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
可惜没能如愿。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
And it's because of you! One night, some guys came to me and said they heard I was a bomb specialist. They demanded I donate bombs to them.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
都怪你！有天晚上，几个人来找我，说听说我是炸弹专家，逼我捐些炸弹给他们。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
One look at them, and I knew they were the infamous ^0000cdBuffalo Bandits^000000. It was obvious why they wanted my bombs.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我一看就知道他们是臭名昭著的^0000cd野牛强盗^000000。他们要我的炸弹干什么，显而易见。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
And you still gave them to them.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
结果你还是给他们了。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
What else could I do? A bunch of scary-looking buffaloes who were at least a head taller than me, mind you? Demanded I give them my bombs.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
那我还能怎么办？那帮野牛一个个凶神恶煞，至少比我高出一头，还命令我交出炸弹。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
You could've stood?
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
你就不能站出来吗？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
No, I couldn't have stood my ground. You weren't there. Anyway, those buffaloes used my bombs to blow up the ore train and take over the mine. Guess what happened to me afterward.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我哪敢跟他们对着干？你当时又不在。总之，那些野牛用我的炸弹炸毁了矿石列车，占领了矿场。猜猜后来我怎么样了？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
The sheriff traced the bombs back to me and dragged me with him.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
警长查到炸弹是我做的，就把我抓走了。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
And you got thrown in jail.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
然后你就进了监狱。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
And guess who I met there: this guy. He was caught in the explosion that blew up the train, and those heartless buffaloes left him to die.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
猜猜我在那儿遇见了谁？就是这家伙。他被炸毁列车时波及，那些冷血的野牛却把他扔在那里等死。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
And the sheriffs were no better than them. They just left him bleeding all over the cell. What could I do? I couldn't let anyone die if I could help it, so I treated him.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
警长也好不到哪去。他们就任由他在牢房里血流不止。我能怎么办？只要还有办法，我就不能见死不救，于是替他治了伤。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
He's been following me around since then.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
从那以后他就一直跟着我。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
Who? Me?
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
谁？我吗？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Yes. Or why did you save me when I came to the mine to get even with the buffaloes? They kicked you out because of me.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
没错。要不然我来矿场找野牛报仇时，你为什么救我？他们还因为我把你赶走了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did you get your revenge after you were released?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你出狱后报仇了吗？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
I don't want to talk about it. I made so many stupid mistakes, which wasn't like me at all. That's why we were hiding out in this dark, dank place.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我不想提那件事。我犯了太多蠢错误，根本不像平时的我。所以我们才躲在这个阴暗潮湿的地方。

scripts.text: So, what can I do to help?
scripts.translation: 那我能帮什么忙？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Are you sure you want to help? Because I don't like forcing people, or sending them in harm's way. If you really want to help, then you can get some bomb materials for me.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
你确定要帮忙？我不喜欢强迫别人，也不想让人冒险。你真想帮的话，就替我找些炸弹材料吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why, so you could rob the mine?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
找材料是为了抢矿场吗？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
No. Technically speaking, we'd ^0000cdreclaim the mine^000000. Have you seen what's going in the village? Since those buffaloes took over the mine, most of the people lost their jobs.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
不，严格来说，我们是要^0000cd夺回矿场^000000。你也看到村里的情况了吧？野牛占了矿场后，大多数人都失业了。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Without a job, they can't make money, and without money, they can't feed themselves. This is terrible.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
没工作就赚不到钱，没钱就没饭吃。实在太糟了。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
I want to throw a ^0000cdfirework party inside the mine^000000 and ^0000cdscare away the bandits^000000.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我想在矿场里办一场^0000cd烟火派对^000000，^0000cd把强盗吓跑^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But, Mr. Midnight, they used to be your...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
可是，午夜先生，他们以前是你的...

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Don't worry about him. He cut ties with them a long time ago. He has no love for those buffaloes who abandoned him. Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
别管他。他早就和他们断绝来往了，对抛弃自己的野牛也没什么感情。对吧？

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
...

[Demon]
Well, I'll be dipped in buttermilk.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
哎哟喂，这下可热闹了。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
No, I'm not worried about them, but I am worried about us. If this goes wrong?
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
我不是担心他们，我是担心我们。万一计划失败了呢？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
The sheriffs will throw us in jail if the bandits don't kill us. But it's okay. I like the beans there.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
要是没被强盗杀掉，我们就会被警长抓进监狱。不过没关系，我喜欢牢里的豆子。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
If this goes well, we can get out of this cesspit and I can work at the mine again. So can you.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
计划顺利的话，我们就能离开这个鬼地方，我也能回矿场工作。你也一样。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Anyway, kiddo, are you sure you can help us? There are monsters inside the mine that looks like cotton balls. Hunt them, and they'll leave behind deadly poisonous powder and explosive powder.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
小家伙，你确定能帮我们吗？矿场里有些像棉花团一样的魔物。猎杀它们就能拿到毒药粉和爆炸粉。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
I need 10 Deadly Poison Powders and.. let me see.. 1 Explosive Powder.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我需要10份毒药粉，还有...让我想想...1份爆炸粉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Deadly poisonous powder? Are you going to kill them? You said you just want to scare them away.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
毒药粉？你要杀了他们吗？你不是说只想把他们吓跑吗？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
It's deadly only to humans and Dorams. To those Tauruses, it only causes allergic reactions, like itching and sneezing.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
这东西只对人类和多兰族致命。那些牛头人只会过敏，发痒、打喷嚏而已。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
I can go.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
我去吧。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
No. You're going to get caught and ruin our plan before it even begins.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
不行，你会被抓，计划还没开始就得泡汤。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Ah kiddo, speaking of which, could you cull some Gasters? That'll help us set up bombs later.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
啊，对了小家伙，你能顺便清理些瓦斯魔吗？之后布置炸弹时用得上。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
The buffaloes would get out of the mine when the fireworks starts, but those clumps of gas could trigger chain reaction and blow up the entire mine. Hunt 15 of them for now. Can you do it?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
烟火一放，野牛就会逃出矿场。不过那些气团可能引发连锁爆炸，把整个矿场炸飞。先猎杀15只吧，能办到吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sure.

[Demon]
I asked yes or no. Oh well, I'll take that as a yes.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我问你行不行呢。算了，我就当你答应了。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Now, here's the lowdown: get ^0000cd10 Deadly Poison Powders and 1 Explosive Powder^000000, and ^0000cdhunt 15 Gasters^000000. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我说说具体要做什么：带来^0000cd10份毒药粉和1份爆炸粉^000000，另外^0000cd猎杀15只瓦斯魔^000000。明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
We'll be counting on you, kiddo! I'll repay you generously when you come back. I was able to nab a few things while in jail at the sheriff's office. Now, off you go!
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
小家伙，这事就拜托你啦！回来后我会好好答谢你。我在警长办公室坐牢时顺了几样东西。好了，出发吧！

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Let's see... Mm, kiddo, you forgot to hunt all the Gasters. We can't have Gasters around while we work.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我看看...嗯，小家伙，你还没把瓦斯魔都清理掉。干活时可不能让它们留在附近。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Hunt just 15 Gasters. There's no rush. You can take your time. Just come back before the end of the day today. I want to see you again.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
猎杀15只瓦斯魔就行，不用着急。今天结束前回来就好，我还想再见你一面。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Let's see... Mm, you didn't bring 10 Deadly Poison Powders. That's the least amount I need to make a bomb.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我看看...嗯，你还没带来10份毒药粉。这是做炸弹所需的最低数量。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Kiddo, you can do this, right? Get 10 Deadly Poison Powders and 1 Explosive Powder from Gasters.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
小家伙，这点事难不倒你吧？去瓦斯魔身上找10份毒药粉和1份爆炸粉。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Let's see... Mm, you didn't bring 1 Explosive Powder. That's the least amount I need to make a bomb.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我看看...嗯，你还没带来1份爆炸粉。这是做炸弹所需的最低数量。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Kiddo, you can do this, right? Get 1 Explosive Powder from Gasters.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
小家伙，这点事难不倒你吧？去瓦斯魔身上找1份爆炸粉。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Let's see... Ooh, kiddo, you got everything done! You hunted Gasters and brought what I asked.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我看看...哇，小家伙，你全都办妥了！瓦斯魔也猎杀了，东西也带齐了。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
This is enough to keep me awake all night.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
这些够我兴奋得一整晚睡不着了。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Hey kiddo, do you mind helping me again tomorrow? I need more than one bomb to throw a firework party.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
嘿，小家伙，明天还能再帮我一次吗？办烟火派对可不止要一颗炸弹。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Go rest today and come back tomorrow in the morning. See ya!
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
今天先去休息，明天早上再来。回头见！

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Aww, just one look at them,
and all I want to do is sneeze...
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
唉，只要看它们一眼，
我就忍不住想打喷嚏...

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
What are you looking at? Were you eavesdropping on me?
Get your butt outta here! Git!
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
看什么看？你在偷听我说话吗？
赶紧给我滚出去！滚！

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Oh, you want to help me again.
Thanks, but I only have to patrol once a day. Why don't you come back tomorrow after 4:00 a.m.?
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
哦，你还想再帮我一次啊。
谢了，不过我一天只巡逻一次。明天凌晨4点后再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Ah, stranger! You came to help again, right?
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
啊，陌生人！你又来帮忙了，对吧？

scripts.text: Help.
scripts.translation: 帮忙。

scripts.text: Decline.
scripts.translation: 算了。

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Why not? Are you too busy today?
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
怎么不帮了？今天有事吗？

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Don't worry about your payment; I've got it covered. Just go get the job done.
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
报酬不用担心，我会负责。你只管把事情办好。

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
*Groan* What do I do?
Maybe I should take a giant fan with me.
No. No, then everyone will find out.
Who's there?!
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
*呻吟* 我该怎么办？
要不带把大风扇过去？
不行，那样大家都会发现的。
谁在那里？！

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Mm? I'm pretty sure I haven't seen you around.
You're not one of the vigilantes.
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
嗯？我肯定没见过你。
你不是义警。

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Wait, you're the stranger
who's been interfering with us!
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
等等，你就是那个一直来坏我们好事的陌生人！

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
...Oh, that's right! Hey stranger,
have you seen the monsters
called Gasters inside the mine?
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
...对了！嘿，陌生人，
你见过矿场里的
瓦斯魔吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 见过。

scripts.text: Gasters?
scripts.translation: 瓦斯魔？

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Yes, those clumps of gas. They make me sneeze something fierce,
and turn into a weeping, drooling, sniffling mess. *Shudder*
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
没错，就是那些气团。害我不停打喷嚏，
弄得眼泪鼻涕直流，狼狈不堪。*打了个寒颤*

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Now, I've been assigned to go on patrol inside the mine, and I can't do it because of them.
But we Taurases take pride in our physical superiority. How can I tell the others that I can't do my job because I'm allergic to some gas?
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
我被派去矿场巡逻，可那些东西害我根本没法去。
我们牛头人一向以体格强壮为傲，我怎么能告诉别人，我因为对某种气体过敏才没法工作？

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
So I'm thinking
maybe you could help me.
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
所以我想，
也许你能帮帮我。

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Hunt ^FF000020 Gasters^000000 before I get in there.
I'll repay you. Please?
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
在我进去前，先猎杀^FF000020只瓦斯魔^000000。
我会报答你的，拜托了！

scripts.text: Help.
scripts.translation: 帮忙。

scripts.text: Decline.
scripts.translation: 拒绝。

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Come on, I said I'd repay you.
Bah! Alright, then I won't force you.
But you'd better not tell anyone about this. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
拜托，我说过会给你报酬。
唉，好吧，我不勉强你。
不过这事可别告诉别人，听见了吗？

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Really? Thanks! I'll be counting on you!
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
真的吗？谢谢！就拜托你了！

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Oh, and make sure no one knows about this.
That'll be bad for both of us.
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
对了，千万别让别人知道。
这对咱俩都不好。

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
How many Gasters did you hunt?
I'm ready to go on patrol. Let me know when you're done.
I'll be counting on you, stranger.
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
你猎杀了多少只瓦斯魔？
我已经准备好去巡逻了。你完成后告诉我。
陌生人，一切就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Did you hunt all of them? By the way, why are you carrying so much stuff?
Go ^FF0000lighten your bag^000000 first.
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
都猎杀完了吗？对了，你怎么带了这么多东西？
先去^FF0000清出些背包空间^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Did you catch them all? I'd better finish my rounds before more of them spring up.
Thanks! Here, take this.
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
都解决了吗？趁它们还没再冒出来，我得赶紧巡逻。
谢了，拿着这个吧。

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
If you're not busy, come by tomorrow and help me again. I'll repay you.
This works for both of us, don't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
有空的话明天再来帮我一次吧，我会付你报酬。
这对我们双方都有好处，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Hello. Are you new to this place? You should be ^FF0000at least Level 100^000000 to stay here comfortably?
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
你好，是新来这里的吗？想在这里待得舒坦，至少得^FF0000达到100级^000000吧？

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Wait, what is my husband feeding that dog? Honey! That was our dinner!
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
等等，我丈夫在喂那只狗什么？亲爱的！那是我们的晚饭！

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
S-sweetheart, you shouldn't be outside when it's so windy. Let's go in.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
亲爱的，风这么大，你不该待在外面。我们进屋吧。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Grr, I can't believe you! You're getting only half your dinner tonight!
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
哼，真不敢相信你！今晚你只能吃一半的晚饭！

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
He's an angel when he's in sleep, but... sigh... I already have a headache, just thinking about what he might do when he wakes up ^FF0000after 4:00 a.m.^000000
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
他睡着时简直像个天使，可是...唉...一想到他^FF0000凌晨4点^000000醒来后又会干出什么事，我就头疼。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Adventurer, thank you for coming back. We've checked all the holes Spotty dug inside the village, but we couldn't find what we were looking for. He must have taken it to the wasteland.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
冒险者，谢谢你回来。我们检查了斑点在村里挖的所有坑，都没找到要找的东西。它肯定把东西叼到荒地去了。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
As I told you before, we've got something for you this time: ^0000CD1 Rock Ridge Coin^000000. Say, could you help us?
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
就像之前说的，这次我们会给你^0000CD1枚洛克理奇硬币^000000。对了，你能帮我们吗？

scripts.text: Help.
scripts.translation: 帮忙。

scripts.text: Decline.
scripts.translation: 拒绝。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
We have no one else to turn to. Please come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
我们实在找不到别人帮忙了。改变主意的话，请再来找我们。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Today Spotty took a slipper. Could you look for it? It may be easily replaceable, but I can't keep buying things every time Spotty takes something.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
斑点今天叼走了一只拖鞋。能帮我找找吗？虽然这些东西不难买，但我不能每次它叼走东西都重新买。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Today Spotty took a spoon. Could you look for it? It may be easily replaceable, but I can't keep buying things every time Spotty takes something.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
斑点今天叼走了一把勺子。能帮我找找吗？虽然这些东西不难买，但我不能每次它叼走东西都重新买。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Today Spotty took a work boot. Could you look for it? It may be easily replaceable, but I can't keep buying things every time Spotty takes something.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
斑点今天叼走了一只工作靴。能帮我找找吗？虽然这些东西不难买，但我不能每次它叼走东西都重新买。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Today Spotty took a glove. Could you look for it? It may be easily replaceable, but I can't keep buying things every time Spotty takes something.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
斑点今天叼走了一只手套。能帮我找找吗？虽然这些东西不难买，但我不能每次它叼走东西都重新买。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Today Spotty took a hat. Could you look for it? It may be easily replaceable, but I can't keep buying things every time Spotty takes something.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
斑点今天叼走了一顶帽子。能帮我找找吗？虽然这些东西不难买，但我不能每次它叼走东西都重新买。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Today Spotty took a pillow cover. Could you look for it? It may be easily replaceable, but I can't keep buying things every time Spotty takes something.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
斑点今天叼走了一个枕套。能帮我找找吗？虽然这些东西不难买，但我不能每次它叼走东西都重新买。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Today Spotty took a flyswatter. Could you look for it? It may be easily replaceable, but I can't keep buying things every time Spotty takes something.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
斑点今天叼走了一只苍蝇拍。能帮我找找吗？虽然这些东西不难买，但我不能每次它叼走东西都重新买。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Today Spotty took a alarm clock. Could you look for it? It may be easily replaceable, but I can't keep buying things every time Spotty takes something.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
斑点今天叼走了一个闹钟。能帮我找找吗？虽然这些东西不难买，但我不能每次它叼走东西都重新买。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Go outside the village and talk to my husband. He'll tell you where it might be.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
去村外找我丈夫谈谈，他会告诉你东西可能在哪儿。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Spotty would be a perfect dog if he doesn't take things out of the house. Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
要是斑点不把家里的东西叼出去，它就真是只完美的狗了。唉...

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Adventurer, we've found the ring!
After all the time we spent searching the village, we've found it inside his house.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
冒险者，我们找到戒指了！
在村里找了半天，最后竟然在他家里找到了。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
By the way, what's that shining thing in your hand?
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
对了，你手里那个闪闪发亮的东西是什么？

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Oh, you want to ^FF0000lighten your bag^000000 first before showing it to me. Sure!
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
哦，你想先^FF0000清出些背包空间^000000再给我看啊。好吧！

scripts.text: Show what's in your hand.
scripts.translation: 把手里的东西给她看。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
This is a Rock Ridge Coin. You can use it like money inside the village. I wasn't comfortable letting you help us for free. I'm glad you can at least have this.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
这是一枚洛克理奇硬币，在村子里可以当钱用。我不想让你白帮忙，能收下这个就好。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
That Rock Ridge Coin is yours. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
这枚洛克理奇硬币给你了，谢谢你帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
And, mm... Do you mind helping us again tomorrow? Spotty keeps taking things from the house to the wasteland, and we need them back.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
还有...你明天能再帮我们一次吗？斑点总把家里的东西叼到荒地去，我们得把东西找回来。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Spotty tired itself out and fell asleep. Could you come back tomorrow after 4:00 a.m.? We'll have something to give you next time.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
斑点累得睡着了。明天凌晨4点以后再来好吗？下次我们会给你准备谢礼。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Did you find what we asked? I can't see it because you're carrying too much stuff with you. Could you ^FF0000lighten your bag^000000 first?
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
找到我们要的东西了吗？你带的东西太多，我看不清。能先^FF0000清出些背包空间^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
You've found it! Thank you so much. We've been trying to correct Spotty's behavior, and it's difficult.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
找到了！太感谢你了。我们一直在努力改掉斑点的坏习惯，可真不容易。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Here's the Rock Ridge Coin we promised. Thank you for searching the wasteland for us.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
这是答应给你的洛克理奇硬币。谢谢你替我们去荒地找东西。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
